Senior Backend Engineer (m/f/d) - Payments Platform

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to own the services behind our payments platform. You will design event-driven systems, operate them in production and mentor other engineers.

Responsibilities
- Design and build backend services in TypeScript and Node.js on AWS
- Model data in PostgreSQL and stream events through Kafka
- Improve API latency and reliability; own on-call for your services
- Drive contract testing and CI/CD practices across teams
- Mentor engineers and review code

Requirements
- 5+ years of backend experience with TypeScript or Java
- Strong PostgreSQL and SQL skills
- Experience with Kafka, Kubernetes and Terraform
- Familiarity with Datadog or Grafana for observability
- Fluent English; German is a plus
